asset.name: Contract notice reminder
asset.description: Sent to the contract owner 60, 30 and 7 days before the notice deadline.
asset.subject: {{reminder_level}}: {{contract.contract_name}} notice deadline in {{days_to_notice}} days
asset.html_body:
A contract notice deadline is coming up

Hi {{contract.owner_name}},

The notice deadline for {{contract.contract_name}} with {{contract.counterparty}} is {{notice_deadline_label}} ({{days_to_notice}} days from {{as_of_date}}).

  • Contract end date: {{contract.end_date}}
  • Notice period: {{contract.notice_period_days}} days
  • Annual value: {{contract.currency}} {{=FORMAT_NUMBER(contract.annual_value, 0)}}
  • If nobody acts, it {{=IF(contract.auto_renew, "renews automatically", "expires on the end date")}}.

{{=IF(days_to_notice <= 30, "A renewal decision task is waiting for you in UserTasks.", "You will get a renewal decision task 30 days before the deadline.")}}

Sent by your contract renewal workflow
